name: Elan The Statement
summary: Project, developer (Elan Group / Elan Enclave Pvt Ltd), Sector 49 Sohna Road location and HARERA number GGM/1022/754/2025/125 are confirmed, and the starting price is within 15% of the developer's ₹10.25 Cr. Differences: the 4 BHK + Study 4,500 sq ft unit and the 7,500 sq ft penthouse are not found (the developer lists 4,340 sq ft and 7,270–7,395 sq ft units), the tower count is 6 on the developer page vs 5 on portals, and the RERA completion date is reported as September 2032 vs our December 2030. The 380-unit figure appears in only one source; others say 458 or 538.
